headlines.title: 摩根大通朱锋：实现全年增长目标，关键在于财政政策执行提速
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月30日讯，“下半年，中国经济的主线预计是可控修复。要想实现全年经济增长目标，关键在于财政政策执行的提速，并在必要时出台增量财政政策，同时将政策资源更好地转化为居民就业与收入增长，进而拉动消费和民间投资。”摩根大通中国首席经济学家朱锋近日在一场宏观经济形势展望会上作出上述研判。朱锋认为，尽管二季度GDP增速回落，上半年中国GDP同比增长4.7%，仍为实现全年GDP增长目标奠定了较好基础。

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan's Zhu Feng: Accelerating fiscal policy execution key to meeting annual growth target
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 30 -- 'In H2, China's economy is expected to focus on controlled recovery. Achieving the annual growth target hinges on accelerating fiscal policy implementation and introducing incremental fiscal measures if necessary, while better converting policy resources into employment and income growth to boost consumption and private investment,' said Zhu Feng, JPMorgan's chief China economist, at a recent macroeconomic outlook meeting. Zhu noted that despite Q2 GDP slowing, H1 year-on-year growth of 4.7% still provides a solid foundation for the annual target.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title_en: Noon market close July 30: STAR 50 index falls over 6% in morning session, consumer sector continues to strengthen
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets oscillated in morning trade, with three major indices sharply lower; STAR 50 fell over 6%. Consumer stocks like baijiu and food continued to rebound, with Yiming Food hitting three consecutive daily limits, and Jinhui Wine and Shede Spirits among those limiting up. Banking sector rallied, with ICBC and CCB hitting record highs. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks fell, with Tongfu Microelectronics and Rockchip limiting down; Hua Hong and Cambricon fell over 10%. Hardware stocks declined, with CIG and Dongshan Precision limiting down; Eoptolink, Zhongji Innolight, and TFC fell over 10%. Losers outnumbered gainers; over 3,400 stocks fell in the Beijing-Shanghai-Shenzhen market. Morning turnover was 1.46 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.15%, the Shenzhen Component fell 3.79%, and the ChiNext fell 5.89%. 2. Sectors: Baijiu, auto, tourism, education led; semiconductors, CPO, memory chips, glass fell.

headlines.title: “美联储传声筒”Nick Timiraos：前瞻指引是央行对未来计划采取的行动，或者在何种情况下将采取某项行动所作出的声明
headlines.summary: “美联储传声筒”Nick Timiraos：前瞻指引是央行对未来计划采取的行动，或者在何种情况下将采取某项行动所作出的声明。这与反应函数有很大不同。反应函数是一种映射关系，例如可以表现为泰勒规则。它并不需要任何预测。反应函数并没有说明经济或政策未来将走向何方；相反，它回答的是在面对特定经济状况、政策权衡或其他因素时，政策应当如何作出回应。

headlines.title_en: Fed whisperer Nick Timiraos: Forward guidance is a central bank's statement on future planned actions or conditions for taking a specific action
headlines.summary_en: "Fed whisperer" Nick Timiraos: Forward guidance is a central bank's statement on future planned actions or conditions for action. This differs from a reaction function, such as the Taylor rule, which doesn't require forecasts and doesn't specify where policy is headed, but rather how policy should respond to specific economic conditions or trade-offs.

headlines.title: 早间要闻汇总
headlines.summary: 科创50指数半日跌超6%，创业板指盘中一度跌6%，大消费板块持续走强。 恒指半日微跌0.03%，恒生科技指数跌1.13%，恒生生物科技指数跌3%。智谱跌超16%，华虹跌超8%。 中际旭创港股破发，上市首日午市收跌逾7%。 三星Q2创史上最强盈利季：净利润暴涨1299.9%超预期，AI芯片狂揽99%利润。 美军称结束对伊朗实施的新一轮大规模打击。 报道：胡塞武装否认拟在曼德海峡征收过境费，称在红海行动仅限于禁止沙特航运。 中国商务部就美国联邦通信委员会将外国电力逆变器和先进机器人设备列入“覆盖清单”事答记者问。 国家能源局：上半年我国煤电发电量占总发电量比

headlines.title_en: Morning news digest
headlines.summary_en: STAR 50 fell over 6% in half-day trading; ChiNext once fell 6%; consumer sector continued to strengthen. Hang Seng Index fell 0.03% at midday; Hang Seng Tech fell 1.13%; Hang Seng BioTech fell 3%. Zhipu fell over 16%; Hua Hong fell over 8%. Zhongji Innolight's Hong Kong listing broke issue price, down over 7% at midday. Samsung Q2 posted record profit: net profit surged 1299.9% beating expectations; AI chips captured 99% of profit. US military claimed to end another large-scale strike on Iran. Report: Houthis denied plans to levy transit fees in the Bab el-Mandeb; Red Sea operations limited to banning Saudi shipping. China's MOFCOM responded to FCC adding foreign power inverters and advanced robotics to 'Covered List'. NEA: H1 coal-fired power accounted for total generation ratio...
